discussion_comments.comment_body: Intentional. Every `@ai-sdk/*` dependency in this package uses a caret range. What Cline ships comes from the lockfile, which pins 5.0.98, because builds install with a frozen lockfile. 5.0.99 and 5.0.100 were kept out of the lock to keep this PR's scope matched to its live verification, not because they are known to break anything. SDK consumers get later patches the same way they do for every other AI SDK dependency.
